clue.text: Foolish prodigality ruined this man of note

definitions.text: Foolish prodigality ruined this man of note

parts.words: Foolish prodigality ruined this man of note
parts.note: describes the Shakespeare title character, a famous Greek nobleman who gave away his fortune lavishly and was left bankrupt and embittered

explanation.surface: A notable figure brought low by reckless spending.
explanation.walkthrough: No wordplay: the clue tells the story of Shakespeare's play, whose hero squanders his wealth on false friends and dies a misanthrope.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's tragedy of a generous Greek lord reduced to poverty by wasteful giving.

clue.text: Salary right for an immigrant

parts.note: a salary is a person's income

explanation.surface: A wage that is fair for someone newly arrived in the country.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has moved into an area or country from elsewhere is a newcomer, an immigrant.

clue.text: Appeal to a big noise in the Norse pantheon

parts.note: O is the cry of appeal or invocation, as in 'O Lord'
a din is a loud noise

explanation.surface: Calling on a mighty deity among the Norse gods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Big noise' looks like slang for a VIP; here it is just a loud racket, DIN.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief god of Norse mythology, father of Thor, sits at the head of that pantheon.

clue.text: Beginning to give vent

definitions.meaning: the start of something, as in the first night of a play
a vent is a hole or gap letting air or gas escape

explanation.surface: Starting to let something out.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a start or debut and an aperture or gap are meanings of the word.

clue.text: Eternal plea of the rejuvenation therapist

definitions.meaning: everlasting, never growing old
a beauty therapist's urging that clients should grow older more slowly, read as two words

explanation.surface: A timeless appeal from someone who sells youthfulness.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into two words for the second reading: a request to 'age less'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something timeless never seems to grow old, so it is everlasting.

clue.text: Section of the editorial meriting attention

indicators.note: Section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a newspaper's leader column that deserves notice.
explanation.definitionFit: To pay attention to something is to take notice of it, giving it the regard it merits.

clue.text: A river once more rising in North America

definitions.text: A river once more rising in North America

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the letters are read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: again means once more

explanation.surface: A river in America swelling up for a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns the whole run A + R + AGAIN upwards, giving NIAGA then R then A; the whole clue also describes the river.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous waterfall river flows between Lakes Erie and Ontario on the US-Canada border.

clue.text: Excuse to provide a regular income

definitions.meaning: to excuse is to forgive or make concessions for someone
to pay someone a fixed periodic sum, as a parent to a student

explanation.surface: A reason given for handing over a steady stipend.
explanation.definitionFit: Both making excuses for someone and granting a periodic payment are senses of the phrase.

clue.text: After refurbishment his hotels earn most

indicators.note: refurbishment remakes something, so these letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Once renovated, a hotelier's buildings bring in the biggest profit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After refurbishment' rearranges HIS HOTELS EARN; 'most' looks like part of the earnings sentence but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest portion of something, from the fable where the lion takes everything.

clue.text: Attribute needed by a secretary

parts.note: a scribe is a clerk or secretary who writes things down

explanation.surface: A quality required of someone doing office work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Attribute' reads as a noun, a quality; it is the verb, to credit.
explanation.definitionFit: To credit something to a source is to assign it, a verb sense rather than the noun quality.

clue.text: Sounds as though I keep myself clean. Bunkum!

indicators.note: says the words are to be heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: a person keeping clean would say 'I wash'

explanation.surface: A boast of personal hygiene dismissed as nonsense.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonsense or humbug talk is called rubbish, claptrap.

clue.text: Give me back my award

indicators.note: give back means the word me is turned round to read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone demanding the return of their trophy.
explanation.definitionFit: The American television prize statuette is an award for programmes.

clue.text: Stored documents without rough edges

definitions.meaning: put papers away in a cabinet
smoothed with a rasp or emery board

explanation.surface: Records kept neat and trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: Both putting papers in order and smoothing with a rasp are senses of the verb.

clue.text: Sore cheek

definitions.meaning: a sore spot on a horse made by chafing
cheek is impudence, nerve

explanation.surface: A painful face.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a chafed blister on skin and brazen impudence are meanings of the word.

clue.text: Insolent talk by self-righteous Florentine artist

parts.note: lip is cheeky backchat
PI, short for pious, means sanctimonious

explanation.surface: A painter from Florence who gives cheek and is smug.
explanation.walkthrough: PI (pious) is a crossword convention for self-righteous. Filippo and Filippino were Renaissance painters of Florence.
explanation.definitionFit: Fra Filippo and his son Filippino were Renaissance painters of the Florentine school.

clue.text: Gaiters are just right in Sunday School

indicators.note: the word in places the right-sounding piece inside the school abbreviation

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for Sunday School
pat means exactly right, apt

explanation.surface: Leg coverings are perfectly suitable for church classes.
explanation.definitionFit: Short cloth coverings worn over the ankle and shoe, a dated fashion.

clue.text: Heather clutches at a way for putting fat on

indicators.note: something that clutches holds the other pieces within its grip

parts.note: ling is a name for heather
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: A plant grasping at a method of fattening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' could be a woman's name; it is the plant LING, which holds A and RD.
explanation.definitionFit: Inserting strips of bacon fat into meat before roasting is a cooking technique.

clue.text: Parson mad with love for a singer

indicators.note: something mad is crazed and disordered, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A clergyman crazy about a female vocalist.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest female or boy voice, and someone who sings that part.

clue.text: In theory it's where journalists work

definitions.meaning: theoretically rather than in practice
reporters work for a newspaper, informally called a paper

explanation.surface: Journalists' workplace in principle.
explanation.definitionFit: Both theoretically, as written down, and employed by a newspaper are readings of the phrase.

clue.text: Sound advice to call my number

definitions.meaning: a single distinctive unit of speech sound in linguistics
an instruction to ring the speaker by telephone, read as two words

explanation.surface: Good counsel to ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective, as in sound advice; it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: In linguistics, the smallest unit of speech that distinguishes one word from another.

clue.text: Managed to continue when given Eastern capital

parts.note: ran means managed, as a business
go on means continue

explanation.surface: Persevering when posted to an Asian city.
explanation.definitionFit: The city now called Yangon was formerly the capital of Burma, in the East.

clue.text: Understands measures in the main

definitions.meaning: grasps, gets to the bottom of
units of six feet for depth at sea; the main is the open sea

explanation.surface: Grasps the depths of the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The main' is a poetic word for the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Both comprehends and units of water depth equal to six feet are senses of the word.

clue.text: Dissension caused by drama documentary

definitions.meaning: discord within a party or group
a blend of fact and fiction in a book or film

explanation.surface: A row sparked by a docudrama.
explanation.definitionFit: Both internal strife and a genre mixing fact with fiction share the word.

clue.text: No limits on fruit

parts.note: O is zero, nothing, as in no
ranges are limits, the extents of something

explanation.surface: A call for unrestricted produce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No limits' reads as a phrase meaning boundless; it splits into O and RANGES.
explanation.definitionFit: Citrus fruits with a bright peel are an example of fruit.

clue.text: Shortly to be nameless

definitions.meaning: soon, in a little while
short for anonymous, without an author's name

explanation.surface: Soon to be unidentified.
explanation.definitionFit: Both soon and anonymous, the abbreviation used for unknown authors, are senses of the word.

clue.text: Son sent to prison for taking a small cut

parts.note: nick is British slang for prison or police station

explanation.surface: A boy jailed for pocketing a share of loot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut' suggests a share of the takings; it is a small notch. NICK is British slang for jail.
explanation.definitionFit: A slight notch or nick made with a blade; in cricket, a faint edge.

clue.text: Try to have a party

definitions.meaning: to have a ... is to have a go, an attempt
a lively celebration

explanation.surface: Have a go at throwing a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Both an attempt and a lively celebration share the informal word.

clue.text: Swot up on King Charles in the morning

parts.note: CR stands for Carolus Rex, Latin for King Charles
AM is ante meridiem, before noon

explanation.surface: Studying a Stuart monarch before lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swot up' is British for studying hard, as before an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Studying intensively at the last minute before a test.

clue.text: Talk quietly but sound, astonished

parts.note: gas is idle chatter
P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Speaking softly yet sensibly, amazed.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp intake of breath is the noise someone makes in surprise.

clue.text: Greeting to comfort the daughter of Inachus?

parts.note: cheer means to comfort or hearten
Io, in Greek myth, was the daughter of the river god Inachus

explanation.surface: Consoling a figure from Greek legend with a hello.
explanation.walkthrough: Io, loved by Zeus and turned into a heifer, was the daughter of Inachus. The answer is British for goodbye, which counts as a greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal British farewell salutation, a parting word.

clue.text: Grannie has changed as a result of rage

indicators.note: changed means the letters are put into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Grandmother transformed by fury.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting while furious, out of wrath.

clue.text: Sort of job popular with Royal Mail employees?

definitions.text: Sort of job popular with Royal Mail employees?

parts.words: Sort of job popular with Royal Mail employees?
parts.note: a secure job for life, imagined as a favourite with postal workers since their work is mail

explanation.surface: Postal workers would love a secure position.
explanation.walkthrough: Royal Mail is the British postal service; post is both a job and the mail.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenured, lasting position of employment rather than a temporary one.
